author: quinnanm
body: Backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51975 **PR description:** This PR was originally https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50908. I have commandeered it as the original author has now left CMS. I then fixed the merge conflicts in order to get this into CMSSW. This is the original PR description: Added valid bit to TkJetWord object TkJetWord now contains 64 bits of data as opposed to 63 before Changed track jet ordering on readout to GTT pattern file to reflect the same order as the firmware (was sorted by pT before, now sorted first by phi then by eta) Added extra output file when running createFirmwareInputFiles_cfg.py called FirmwareGeometryFile.vh. If any of the JetFinding parameters change like eta bin centers or cuts on track multiplicity, regenerate FirmwareGeometryFile.vh and place it in the /algo/components/jet/firmware/hdl/ directory of the JetFinding firmware. Presentation of changes in a talk coming soon **PR validation:** Original validation: Valid bit present in track jet words in GTT test vector files Used FirmwareGeometryFile.vh in the firmware and checked emulator test vector output against firmware. They match. New validation: Ran: scram b distclean scram b -j 8 scram build code-checks scram build code-format The L1T Menu team saw that the TkJet Performance changed with this PR. [I ran a validation to confirm that this was due to changing the minimum track pT for the tracks considered in the TkJet to 10 GeV](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1728721/#10-tracks-vertex). This is required to match the current FW.
title: [17_0_X][L1T] GTT Jet Finding Geometry Readout (Phase 2) (backport)
